sale_pattern: Heavy markdowns; clearance items not returnable
notes: Homepage mission: 'LA-born and style-obsessed, we empower self-expression through standout fashion at unbeatable value.' Slogan 'FASHION IS FOR EVERYONE.' Nav includes Dresses and Plus.
Shipping: 'Currently, we ship only to all 50 states of the U.S.' Standard $9.99, free on orders of $50 or more (Forever 21 merchandise); express $20.99.
Returns: refund within 30 days of receipt; $9.99 return shipping fee per return; Final Sale and clearance items non-returnable. Policy pages carry '© 2025 Brands Online, LLC'.

Wikipedia: founded in Los Angeles in 1984; filed Chapter 11 on 17 March 2025 and closed all US stores by 1 May 2025; Authentic Brands Group owns the IP; relaunch announced September 2025 as an online retailer. The page's operator is not named beyond the Brands Online, LLC copyright, so parent_company is empty.
